description: GhostClaw Telegram Bot inline keyboard commands for agent management

gc_status.label: 🔍 Status
gc_status.description: Show all 11 agents health, queue status, and bridge state

gc_sync.label: 🔄 Sync
gc_sync.description: Trigger full A2A bridge sync cycle across all agents

gc_activate.label: ▶ Activate
gc_activate.description: Activate all pending queue tasks for processing

gc_start.label: ▶ Start Agent
gc_start.description: Start a specific agent by name (prompt for agent ID)
gc_start.input_prompt: Which agent to start? (hermes, codex, opencode, zcode, kiro, copilot, claude, antigravity2, webmcp, planner, zai_tui)

gc_stop.label: ⏹ Stop Agent
gc_stop.description: Stop a specific agent by name (prompt for agent ID)
gc_stop.input_prompt: Which agent to stop? (hermes, codex, opencode, zcode, kiro, copilot, claude, antigravity2, webmcp, planner, zai_tui)

gc_dashboard.label: 📊 Dashboard
gc_dashboard.description: Return the GhostClaw dashboard URL and status links
gc_dashboard.response:
📊 GhostClaw Dashboard
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

gc_reset.label: 🔁 Reset Bridge
gc_reset.description: Reset bridge state to clean running state
gc_reset.confirm_text: Are you sure you want to reset the bridge state? This will clear all agent connection states.

gc_logs.label: 📋 Logs
gc_logs.description: Show recent bridge logs and outbox counts

gc_help.label: ❓ Help
gc_help.description: Show the Telegram command menu with all available buttons
gc_help.response:
🤖 GhostClaw Telegram Commands
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔍 Status — Show all 11 agents health + queue + bridge
🔄 Sync — Trigger A2A sync cycle across all agents
▶ Activate — Activate all pending queue tasks
▶ Start Agent <name> — Mark a specific agent as running
⏹ Stop Agent <name> — Mark a specific agent as stopped
📊 Dashboard — Show dashboard URL and links
🔁 Reset Bridge — Reset bridge to clean state
📋 Logs — Show recent bridge logs
❓ Help — Show this menu

Type the callback_data to execute a command, e.g.: gc_status
